title: A Crown for the Wolf Revisited
author: I. M. Lockridge
blurb: Quentin Coldharbour, the last oath-bound swordspeaker, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
